LESSON: BOOK HANDLING SKILLS (1 1/

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.1: Book handling Skills (1 1/

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Book handling Skills (1 1/. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how to turn pages books on shelves?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Book handling Skills (1 1/
2. Practise Book handling Skills (1 1/ at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Book handling Skills (1 1/

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Book handling Skills (1 1/
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Book handling Skills (1 1/. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Book handling Skills (1 1/ at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Book handling Skills (1 1/ at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Book handling Skills (1 1/
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Book handling Skills (1 1/. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Book handling Skills (1 1/ using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Book handling Skills (1 1/ in the examples.
2. Explain Book handling Skills (1 1/ to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Book handling Skills (1 1/.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Book handling Skills (1 1/ using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Book handling Skills (1 1/ important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Be involved in a c) Participate in storing books writing walk where they turn pages properly in and out of school. from right to left as they scribble on each page.
2. In groups, learners could be guided to arrange books on shelves. 31
3. Observe a demonstration on how to cover books and imitate.
4. Learners should practise how to hold a book appropriately whenever opportunities arise.
5. In groups, learners could practise holding the book up-side-up, sing songs and recite poems and rhymes on how to hold books properly.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to turn pages books on shelves?
2. how to handle books • Learners could be encouraged to mishandle books?
3. How do we take care of b) Enjoy participating in book right as demonstrated. books?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Book handling Skills (1 1/
2. Practise Book handling Skills (1 1/ at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Book handling Skills (1 1/
